entries.text: 我就當[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳是願意\n教奧爾迪加他們功課囉，ＯＫ？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_01

entries.text: 這件事不著急，\n不論什麼時候都no problem的。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_02

entries.text: 那麼，讓我們專心來stand by，\n準備開始study吧！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_03

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳其他事情都辦完了？\n可以教大家功課了嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_01

entries.text: 嗯，我知道了！\n我們會一直等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_02

entries.text: 太棒了～！\n那麼，我帶[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳到教室去！[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_03

entries.text: 大家～\n有沒有好好在用功啊～？[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_04

entries.text: 真囉嗦。\n你是來監視我們的嗎？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_01

entries.text: 誰叫你們沒人看著的話\n就會偷懶。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_05

entries.text: 枇琶閣下穿著正裝的樣子……[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_01

entries.text: 不論看多少次，\n都能讓在下提高集中力。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_02

entries.text: 秋明，真是抱歉。讓你提高了\n跟考試毫無關係的集中力了……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_04

entries.text: 唔嗯！？枇琶閣下的背後\n有著他人的氣息……？[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_03

entries.text: 是不法之徒嗎！？出來！\n快給在下現身！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_04

entries.text: 是老師！
entries.label: s2_sub_008_select_02

entries.text: 這股常人無法散發的氣息若是來自\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]閣下，便不意外了。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_05

entries.text: 不不，這是怎麼一回事啊？\n為什麼[VAR 0x0100(0000)]會在這裡～？[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_03

entries.text: 哦哦，在下感激不盡！\n實在不勝感激！[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_06

entries.text: 啥～！？我可沒聽說這件事！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_04

entries.text: 話說回來，皮拿！\n你不要擅自決定！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳也是！我才不需要\n什麼老師，快回去！[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_06

entries.text: 但你卻對[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她說出\n那麼失禮的話……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_07

entries.text: 你　該　道　歉　的　人　不　是　我　吧？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_09

entries.text: 氣勢驚人的枇琶閣下……\n實在罕見。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_07

entries.text: 奧爾迪加他是不想\n讓[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳看到他的矬樣。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_07

entries.text: 梅洛可閣下在幾個時辰前\n說要去做伸展運動，\r\n便大搖大擺地離去了。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_08

entries.text: 她絕對是在偷懶！\n她可是梅洛可耶。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_09

entries.text: 嗯～雖然我覺得\n一口咬定是不好的……[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_11

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，不好意思，\n可以請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳幫忙去找梅洛可嗎？\r\n我想她至少人會在學院裡的！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_08

entries.text: 我們會在[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳去找她的時候，\n把適合讀書的環境stand by起來的！[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_09

entries.text: 能提高專注力的ＢＧＭ……\n再怎麼說萊姆的曲子還是不適合吧。[VAR 0x0114(0021)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_aku_10

entries.text: 最近梅洛一直在讀書，\n所以說不定她是去活動一下身體？[VAR 0x0114(0022)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_kakutou_13

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳來當老師，\n也就是說[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳連成績都很好？\r\n樣樣精通，真讓我不爽。[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_fairy_10

entries.text: 學問之道錯綜複雜宛如迷宮，\n懇請多多鞭策，多多指教。[VAR 0x0114(0023)]
entries.label: s2_sub_008_doku_09
